prompt: David, a network administrator, is receiving a high volume of emails from a specific domain, `bulkmailers.com`. He wishes to automatically discard any emails larger than 5MB from this domain using Sieve. Which Sieve script will achieve this?
explanation: The script first checks that the message is from the `bulkmailers.com` domain, then nests a `size :over 5000000` test so that only messages larger than 5MB are discarded.
